title: Drunk 21-Year-Old Snaps and Chokeslams Her Mom at Birthday Party
description:
On June 25th, 2022. During a birthday party, a 21-year-old loses her cool on her mom and aunt after she gets highly intoxicated. When police arrived, they noticed pulled hair and fingernails scattered all over the apartment. They spoke with mom and she stated that her daughter got violent and grabbed her neck and threw her.  It turns out the the daughter had some animosity towards her mom due to her abandoning her at a young age. 

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
